cards.subject: a bright IKEA Kids bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table and poufs
cards.scene: A light room with a pine plank floor. A powder blue cotton rug with wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low flower-shaped birch craft table, a stack of ochre and barberry bouclé poufs and a low white bed with powder blue bedding. Soft afternoon light from a window on the RIGHT lies in patches on the floor. At the left edge of the frame an open white door leads into the room; a toddler girl of about two and a half in a sunny ochre knit sweater and cream trousers has just come through it and stands two steps inside the room at the left edge of the frame with her back to the camera, in mid-stride with both arms swinging out to the sides, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: pale birch, ochre, barberry red and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

cards.subject: a calm Playful Curves nursery for a baby under 2, with a round quilted mat and a low birch book ledge
cards.scene: A quiet cream room with a pale ash herringbone floor. A cream oval rug with scalloped edges holds a wooden push-along walker cart and a few wooden blocks beside the cot. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a round quilted sage organic cotton mat with wooden sensory blocks, a low birch book ledge with two board books, and a slatted birch cot 120 by 60 cm with sage bedding. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the LEFT lie in soft patches on the floor. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme right edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: cream, pale birch, soft clay pink, butter yellow and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A toddler girl of about two and a half in a sunny ochre knit sweater and cream trousers, standing just inside the open doorway at the left edge of the frame with her back to the camera, runs a few quick happy steps across the floor toward the mural wall and stops about two metres in front of it; on the last step both arms rise high above her head in delight and she stands still. Her face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of her head, her hair and her clothes are seen. The white door stays exactly as it is, open. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
clips.items: flower-shaped craft table, bouclé poufs, low white bed, rug, crayon cup, drawing book, picture frame and architecture

clips.motion: A smooth slow first-person walk-in: the camera advances steadily straight forward into the room at natural eye level, as if a person is slowly entering, with no sideways drift, no tilt and no rotation. The sheer cream curtain in the extreme foreground on the right leaves the frame as the camera advances past it, and the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones, giving a natural depth parallax.
